f24ac736acad8b37.answer: {"subreddit":"TalesFromTheCustomer","title":"The Museum Clerk Charged Me for Someone Else","script":"The museum clerk charged me for another visitor’s entire purchase, then insisted the register could not undo it. I had bought one postcard, but my receipt showed 7 souvenirs and a membership I never requested. She waved me aside because a tour group was waiting and said accounting would call next month. I photographed the receipt, the single postcard, and the untouched bag still behind her counter. Then I asked the security guard to witness me returning every item listed under my name. The clerk suddenly claimed those souvenirs belonged to a different customer, which was exactly my point.
